sql: CREATE TRIGGER fixture_fail_signin_audit BEFORE INSERT ON account_audit WHEN NEW.action='sign-in' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'fixture audit denied'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER fixture_fail_request BEFORE INSERT ON challenges BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'fixture request denied'); END;
